subject: Renewal: Option to move to AWS Marketplace billing for Q2 renewal
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medstrip.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medstrip.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: Option to move to AWS Marketplace billing for Q2 renewal

Hi Laura / MedStrip procurement team,

Hope you're well — our records show your Redwood subscription is up for renewal on 2026-04-30. I wanted to surface an option that could simplify procurement and invoicing for you: moving the subscription to the AWS Marketplace (metered/listing) for your renewal. Several customers we've worked with have moved renewals to marketplace billing to consolidate vendor management and take advantage of cloud spend controls.

High-level benefits: 
- Single invoice through AWS Marketplace (no separate vendor invoice)
- Easier PO and chargeback for your finance team
- Potential co-sell support from AWS for certain expansion motions

If this is of interest, we can: 
1) Provide a short checklist for the transition (contract amendment, SaaS listing mapping, billing account info).
2) Generate a DocuSign amendment and coordinate a no-downtime switchover for billing.
3) Loop in our Partner/Marketplace team to enable co-sell benefits.

Quick question: does MedStrip prefer to receive a marketplace-based invoice (via AWS) for renewals going forward, or would you like us to keep the existing direct invoice model? If marketplace is preferable, please confirm the procurement contact and any internal ordering codes we should include.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138

---
Attachment (referenced): marketplace-transition-checklist.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Option to move to AWS Marketplace billing for Q2 renewal

Raf — copying Connor from Partnerships to help with the seller-side flow. Attached a short checklist we use for transitions (contract amendment + seller listing mapping). If MedStrip wants marketplace billing we should: 

- Confirm billing account ID and procurement PO process (customer)
- Draft a short amendment (we'll attach as "AWS-SaaS-Contract-Amendment.docx")
- Start a Marketplace listing change request in Seller Central (Connor)
- Confirm seat/usage mapping so nothing changes technically for the customer

Connor: can you pre-seed the Seller Central request and estimate lead time? Also flag any co-sell qualification steps if MedStrip meets them.

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---
Attachment (sent): AWS-SaaS-Contract-Amendment.docx
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medstrip.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medstrip.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Option to move to AWS Marketplace billing for Q2 renewal

Rafael — thanks for flagging. Procurement here (Laura) — MedStrip would like to move to marketplace billing for the renewal. Our reasons: easier central billing, our Cloud Ops wants the cost surfaced in AWS, and our finance team prefers a single vendor on the AWS invoice.

Procurement details: 
- Contact: Laura Chen (me)
- Billing Owner: procurement@medstrip.com
- AWS Account ID: 111222333444
- PO requirements: We will issue a PO referencing the Marketplace SaaS listing and your DocuSign amendment.

Please send the amendment and any Seller Central steps. We may need the listing SKU/reference to include on our PO. Can you also confirm whether pricing tiers or discounts will map 1:1 in Marketplace? If there are any differences we need them spelled out before we issue a PO.

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Procurement | MedStrip Health
laura.chen@medstrip.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medstrip.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@medstrip.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: Option to move to AWS Marketplace billing for Q2 renewal

Thanks Laura — great, happy to proceed. Next steps and owner list: 

1) I will initiate the DocuSign amendment today (Rafael) — links below. Amendment is limited: it assigns billing to AWS Marketplace for the renewal term and leaves service terms unchanged.
2) Marissa / Connor will open the Seller Central change request and provide the listing SKU so your PO can reference it (Marissa / Connor).
3) Laura / procurement will issue a PO referencing the SKU and the amendment.
4) Once DocuSign is complete and the SKU/PO are matched, we will toggle billing on the renewal date. No service interruption expected.

Pricing mapping: The Marketplace listing will mirror your current committed pricing exactly — no hidden uplift. Any discounts that were part of your direct contract will be reflected on the amendment and carried to the listing. If you want a written pricing table we can attach it to the amendment before signature.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcd1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DL-2026-0112
Seller Central request (internal): https://sellercentral.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/seller/listings/7654321

I'll get the DocuSign sent and loop back once signed. If procurement needs a direct invoice copy for the interim, we can provide one.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138
